review_notes: I read the whole file. It is a worked example that builds a 2×2 channel from PMFs, a Markov kernel, a density and a ContinuousPositiveDensity witness. I searched Mathlib for an existing PMF-to-ProbabilityMeasure bundling def (`toProbabilityMeasure`) and for PMF-to-Kernel constructions. Neither exists, so `twoByTwoRows` and `twoByTwoKernel` don't compete with an existing declaration. `Kernel.ofFunOfCountable` and `PMF.ofFintype` are already used. I found no avoidable competing version of a Mathlib concept. I did not check for a binary-symmetric-channel definition beyond these searches. I did not check the library's own Discharged or Finite files, which the rubric does not cover.
